body:
Dear friend,

All spring, the brothers have been copying a new book of stories for the library in Bellhaven. It's nearly finished!

The very last page needs a border. Will you come and paint it with me?
summary: Paint a border in the monastery's new book.

tasks.where: in the scriptorium at the monastery (walk the road, or take the map)
at the coop by your house
from the jug in your kitchen
